notes_for_editor: Access, staffing and fire history are unverified. The tn.gov state forest page failed to load (connection reset) and the Overton County News history returned HTTP 429. Open question: Wikipedia names a 'Goodpasture Mountain Firetower' and gives Goodpasture Mountain the same 1,493 ft figure Tennessee Landforms gives for Standing Stone. We could not confirm these are one tower. The Tennessee Landforms code 'GB2402 4-11' is not interpreted. The brief's elevation (455.1 m) matches the 1,493 ft figure.
